title: Naruto Quiz
tagline: Same engine, different village. Prove you were paying attention.
spoiler: Spoiler warning: Medium covers all of Part 1 and early Shippuden. Hard goes to the end of the series.
controls: Keys `1`-`4` pick an answer, `Enter` moves on.
20 seconds per question. Answer fast for more points.
about:
Fifteen questions per difficulty, pulled at random from a larger bank.

**Easy** is the Academy and the Land of Waves. **Medium** runs through Part 1 and into Shippuden. **Hard** is for people who can name Akatsuki members without looking.

Scoring works the same as the One Piece quiz: speed and streaks are where the points actually come from.
